response.sql: WITH high_rate_fees AS (SELECT f.orderslink, f.feerate, f.rebrate, o.dealedge FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009), group_stats AS (SELECT orderslink, dealedge, AVG(feerate - rebrate) as group_avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM high_rate_fees GROUP BY orderslink, dealedge), side_stats AS (SELECT dealedge, AVG(group_avg_net_fee_rate) as side_avg FROM group_stats GROUP BY dealedge) SELECT gs.orderslink, gs.dealedge, gs.group_avg_net_fee_rate, gs.record_count, (gs.group_avg_net_fee_rate - ss.side_avg) as difference FROM group_stats gs JOIN side_stats ss ON gs.dealedge = ss.dealedge WHERE gs.group_avg_net_fee_rate > ss.side_avg ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
